# Town of Fairfield municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 8; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists five Fairfield Selectboard members: Ronald Bocash, Damian Brannon, Brian Dubie, Thomas Howrigan (Chair), and David Persons.

Town of Fairfield Selectboard minutes, July 13, 2026: the July 13, 2026 minutes seat the same five (Howrigan chairing, Persons as Secretary), printing 'Damian Branon'; the town's own spelling governs the name recorded here. Gavin Ryan sat in December 2025 but is not on the current board and is not minted.

Town of Fairfield Selectboard minutes, April 13, 2026 (draft): 'Ron made a motion to appoint Demetrius Bolduc as Fairfield Town Clerk, as authorized pursuant to 17 V.S.A. Chapter 2651e. Damian seconded. All in favor.' Bolduc was sworn in at the same meeting. Linda Hodet, the elected clerk, had stepped down and sits in the attendance list as Interim Town Clerk; the board welcomed Bolduc as the new Town Clerk and thanked Hodet for her years of service. Fairfield's voters approved converting the town clerk to an appointed office under 17 V.S.A. §2651e at the March 3, 2026 annual town meeting. CORRECTION (2026-10-26): the batch-8 build recorded Bolduc as elected with the mode unverified, working from the June 22, 2026 minutes only; the April 13 minutes establish the appointment, and he is recorded as appointed.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Linda Hodet as Town Clerk of Fairfield (January 2026). Hodet stepped down in early 2026, served as Interim Town Clerk, and was succeeded by the appointed Bolduc on April 13, 2026.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Amanda Forbes as Town Treasurer of Fairfield.
Town of Fairfield Selectboard minutes, December 17, 2025: the December 17, 2025 minutes header names Amanda Forbes as Treasurer.
